answer_1.quote: Our experiments are mainly conducted on Natural Language Response Generation task (NLG), a critical component in a ToD system to accurately generate relevant system responses given the dialog history and system acts, where large pretrained models serve an ideal purpose.
answer_1.outputs: system responses in a target language given dialog history and system acts

answer_2.quote: We use sacreBLEU to evaluate the overall n-gram match between generated and ground truth responses and Slot Error Rate (SER) to measure the percentage of correct predicted slots in a generated response.
